fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political commentary centered on Miami police controversies involving Huttoe, Capt. J. E. Barker, and related civil service proceedings, with criticism of Miami daily newspapers’ coverage. Additional coverage addresses city commissioner H. Leslie Quigg and allegations concerning the Ku Klux Klan, discussion of legalized gambling/bookmaking policy in Florida, and reports on Florida oil drilling activity. Local civic topics include Miami Transit bus stop changes affecting small businesses and traffic, Miami Beach/Crandon Park public access and tourism concerns, and Miami city court reports on arrests and disturbances; other items include a University of Miami debate on climate factors and assorted columns and advertisements.
